hooks.command: input=$(cat); printf "%s" "$input" | grep -q "git commit" || exit 0; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; out=$(.venv/Scripts/python -m pytest tests/test_docs_structure.py -q 2>&1) && exit 0; echo "docs-structure tests FAILED - the docs drifted from the code; fix before committing:" >&2; echo "$out" | tail -15 >&2; exit 2
hooks.statusMessage: Checking the docs are in sync before the commit

hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; last=$(git log -1 --format=%H -- "docs/archive/session_*.md" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$last" ] || exit 0; n=$(git rev-list --count "$last..HEAD" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ "$n" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null || exit 0; d=$(git log -1 --format=%ad --date=short); printf "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"SessionStart\",\"additionalContext\":\"chaosco wrap-up check: %s commit(s) since the last session summary in docs/archive/ (newest commit %s). If the previous session ended without /wrap-up, offer Marina to run /wrap-up for it before starting new work.\"}}" "$n" "$d"
hooks.statusMessage: Checking for unwrapped work from the last session
